translation.guide_level1_tip1: Click on the position you want to move
translation.guide_level1_desc2: The middle 1 indicates one landmine in the surrounding 8 plots,
translation.guide_level1_tip2: Click on the marked landmine once in the non-safe zone
translation.guide_level1_tip3: Click on the non-safe zone plot
translation.guide_level1_desc4:
Based on the middle number 1, it is known that there is one mine around, 
 and the mine has been marked. 
 determines that the remaining non-safe zone plots can all be opened.
translation.guide_level1_tip4: Click the middle number 1 to place the detonator
translation.guide_level1_title5: Place the detonator to blow up the surrounding area
translation.guide_level1_title6: Walk to the exit and pass through customs
translation.guide_level2_title1: Switch between mine marking and mine removal
translation.guide_level2_desc1: Click repeatedly at the same spot in a non-safe zone to toggle mine marking/clearing
translation.guide_level2_tip1:
1. In the non-safe area, click once to mark the mine 
2. In the same place, click for the second time and change to mine clearance 
3. Clicking the same place for the third time will cancel
translation.guide_level2_title3: The order can be cancelled before the soldier arrives
translation.guide_level2_tip4: Click on the location around the hostage
translation.guide_level2_title5: You can rescue the hostage from all directions, up, down, left and right
translation.guide_level3_title2: Detect whether there are any mines in the plot
translation.guide_level3_title4: Continue the operation to complete the mine clearance
translation.guide_level3_title5: The consumption of action power continues
translation.guide_level4_title1: Complete daily tasks to earn gold coins
translation.guide_level4_tip1: Click to open the daily tasks
